summary: Preserve Tock experience-card combobox booking support and OpenTable persisted-query operation-name consistency for harvested availability hashes.
reason: Tock venues can render a time combobox plus experience cards instead of per-time slot buttons, so the chromedp booking flow must drive that layout and report page-state controls on selector drift. OpenTable now validates that the JSON operationName, URL opname, and persisted-query hash's registered operation name all match, so the availability hash cache must carry the harvested operation name as well as the hash.
validated_outcome: Unit coverage pins combobox time selection, party-size experience-card disambiguation, Tock page-state hints, OpenTable hash+operation-name persistence, and body operationName/URL opname consistency.
